newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Recticel says not for sale.
newsitem.headline: Recticel says not for sale.

text.p: Belgian polyurethane foam maker Recticel SA said that its parent company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) was not about to sell its 70 percent stake in Recticel.

"I am sure that Mr Liotier has not said that he wanted to sell us. I think there is no intention that I am aware of or persuaded of that SGB is looking to divest out of Recticel," Recticel chief executive officer Luc Vansteenkiste told a news conference about 1996 earnings.
"It is not their priority (to sell Recticel)," he added.
On Monday, Liotier was quoted as saying in a magazine that SGB would not hold on to its Recticel stake forever.
